data.title: Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass and Seasonal Events
data.summary: Event Pass, Solidus Node map, and Black Friday offers arrive.
data.meta_title: Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass and Seasonal Events
data.meta_description: Event Pass, Solidus Node map, and Black Friday offers arrive.
data.content:
Tortuga has erupted into open conflict, and the frontier is shifting once again. As factions scramble for control of the embattled city, advanced tech, covert simulations, and rare opportunities are surfacing across the system. 

This update opens access to powerful equipment, secretive training grounds, and limited-time advantages—crucial assets for any Pilot hoping to survive the chaos now unfolding.

Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass

From November 25 to December 8, the Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass delivers battlefield-shaping gear: Zenit rocket launcher and Kinetic Pulse Supply Gear, along with Pilots Continuum and Emma James. 

Gather vital resources and unlock pirate-themed cosmetics as you carve a path through Tortuga’s streets.

Event Map: Solidus Node Is Live

November 25–December 9 marks the return of Solidus Node: Foundry in a dedicated unranked queue. This stripped-down simulation environment challenges Pilots to gear up and push their War Robots to the limit.

Intel Discount Event

From November 25 to December 2, upgrading your War Robots becomes easier with Intel discounts—perfect for enhancing your combat setups. This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following Builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Raven, Bulwark, Ceres, Matriarch (Titan)
  • Weapons: Gozer, Thunder, Bisector, Hive (Matriarch)
  • Gear: Blast Wave, Infinite Ammo, Holofield, Nanite Repair, Ghost Turret, Reflector

Black Friday Discounts

Black Friday Deals Are Here! Save Big on Bundles, Modules, Cosmetics, and Pilots.

Use promo code SINGULARITYDEAL to claim a 3-Day Premium and 5000 Salvage during the event.

Suit up, power on, and take the fight to Tortuga!
